CONSEQUENCES FOR DISPATCH, both of which have cost lanes time: (1) a blocker count is NOT a measure of how wrong the TU's data is, so it must never be read as source debt or as a reason to defer the TU -- the fix is deriving the address range and adding the splits.txt claim (the workflow run-51's enemy.c order already specifies: tools/gdl/composed_census/af_data_base_census.py emits paste-ready claims); (2) the blocker axis is DECOUPLED from the open-function axis, so the two halves of a flip can be dispatched to different lanes in the same run, and a TU with 0 open functions can still be a non-flip purely because of a splits.txt line (game/anim/atree: 36/36 functions matched, one unclaimed 4-byte .sdata2). The DATA-DEBT rows datadiff already scores advisory (target's extra bytes zero over an identical head: atree .rodata 0x17C vs 0x17B, action .data 0x850 vs 0x848) are a different class and are correctly not blockers.
